# We believe in the power of science to transform our world.

Together with scientists and operators worldwide, we empower progress by providing trusted insights
and services that accelerate work and amplify impact for a healthier, safer, and more sustainable
world.

[Biopharma][240] [Applied Solutions][241] [Food Solutions][242]


# We drive efficiency and empower sustainable scientific discovery with nearly 90 years of
# pioneering innovation.

[Discover More][243]


## By your side, globally.

Offices in 35 countries.

Customers served in 168 countries (direct and through distributors).

Manufacturing presence in North-America, Europe and APAC, incl. China.


## People power progress.

We believe great ideas can come from anywhere – because our customers rely on the ingenuity,
creativity, and passion of our people.

We’re on a mission to transform our world. Will you join us?

[Explore Careers][244]


## Conveniently find parts for your instrument and place orders with our new online store.

[Shop Now][245]
❮
❯
 

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

Our focus is enabling the most innovative discovery, measurement, and testing solutions across our
strategic growth platforms.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

main purpose is exporting to the international market and servicing overseas clients. Drawell

## Reliability, service and support you can trust.

Eschmann is an industry-leading British company designing and manufacturing medical products and
services to clinical professionals worldwide, both direct and through our network of trusted
distributors.

With nearly 200 years of experience, Eschmann offer a diverse range of high-quality, reliable
infection control and surgical products. Plus, all equipment in the UK is supported by our
unrivalled service and support offering, with over 50 Eschmann engineers nationwide.


To find out more [ talk to us today. ][203]

### Over 190 years of continuous innovation

At Eschmann, we are proud of our history and heritage. We were first established in 1830 and started
life manufacturing elastic gum instruments in central London. After establishing the Eschmann brand
in surgical instruments, we went on to use our experience to manufacture operating theatre tables,
electrosurgery, surgical suction units and autoclaves. Today, we are proud to manufacture autoclaves
and surgical suction devices in Lancing, West Sussex, the same business park Eschmann was located in
over 80 years ago.

[Learn More][208]

### Consumables you can trust, available to purchase online

The Eschmann range of consumables and accessories covers every aspect of your infection control
protocols. Available to purchase online, our trustworthy range of products are here to keep you,
your environment and your equipment safe, clean and compliant.

[View Consumables & Accessories][209]

## Reliability, service and support you can trust.

Eschmann is an industry-leading British company designing and manufacturing medical products and
services to clinical professionals worldwide, both direct and through our network of trusted
distributors.

With nearly 200 years of experience, Eschmann offer a diverse range of high-quality, reliable
infection control and surgical products. Plus, all equipment in the UK is supported by our
unrivalled service and support offering, with over 50 Eschmann engineers nationwide.

### Over 190 years of continuous innovation

At Eschmann, we are proud of our history and heritage. We were first established in 1830 and started
life manufacturing elastic gum instruments in central London. After establishing the Eschmann brand
in surgical instruments, we went on to use our experience to manufacture operating theatre tables,
electrosurgery, surgical suction units and autoclaves. Today, we are proud to manufacture autoclaves
and surgical suction devices in Lancing, West Sussex, the same business park Eschmann was located in
over 80 years ago.

The Eschmann range of consumables and accessories covers every aspect of your infection control
protocols. Available to purchase online, our trustworthy range of products are here to keep you,
your environment and your equipment safe, clean and compliant.

Esma offers a unique approach to automating the ultrasonic cleaning process by transferring liquids to a single ultrasonic process chamber from individual heated storage tanks. By moving the fluids and not the parts, the entire system can be closed with each storage tank covered and vented. The cover of the process unit, which also acts as the dryer, can be vented to exhaust any chemical fumes out of the work environment. PLC and touchscreen HMI controls give the operator full access to program changes and data, which can be recorded for process validation and control. Multi-tank and benchtop ultrasonic cleaning equipment complete the ultrasonic cleaner line. Our solid state circuitry supplies AC voltage to transducers with a continuous, complete square ware at a constant amplitude. This produces multiple harmonics to the bath. This circuitry tends to fill the less active areas in the bath providing more homogenous cleaning. The automatic tuning and sweep design adjusts the primary resonant frequency at 38 Khz for changes in loads and liquid levels. [Ultrasonic Cleaning Animation] Esma also manufactures a line of benchtop electropolishing equipment and corresponding electropolishing solutions. These units have been utilized in the dental lab market as well as medical device applications for low volume production of precision parts. Our electropolishing solution for cobalt chromium has been recognized for its excellence throughout the world and is used to electropolish stents for many of the major medical manufacturers. ## Company Overview

Qingdao Flom Technology Co., Ltd is one professional manufactory of water treatment system, lab
furniture and prepainted and galvanizedsteel coils. we FLOM is one high-tech enterprise integrating
design, product R&D, manufacture, sale and service. We have workshop near 3000 square meters and the
existing staff is near to 60 staff; and we got ISO 9001:2008 amd CE Approved, till now our products
have been exported successfully to S. Korea, Japan, Sudan, Egypt, Tajikistan, Viet Nam, Libya,
Yemen, Indonesia, Australia, India, etc. Our products include: 1, Laboratory water purification
system.Medical water purification system. 2, Industrial pretreatment equipment, like Quartz sand
filter,acticarbon filter, softening resin filter,etc.Industrial RO sytem, Industrial EDI system. 3,
Water softener system. 4, Laboratory central bench/side bench, fume hood, all kinds of storage
cabinets like vessel cabinets, medical cabinets, reagent cabinet, etc 5, New Products: glassware
washer-disinfector, ice making machine, lab membrane separate equipment, etc 6, All kinds of
prepainted galvanized steel coils (PPGl), hot dipped galvanized steel coils (GI), color pressing
style steel sheets, color laminate composite boards, color composite boards with
polystyeplastic(EPS)or polyurethane(PU) or rockwool, plastic-steel composite boards with UPVC
material. "Efficient, Energy saving, Environmental protection" is our aim. Our products are applied
widely in scientific research, college and university, environmental protection, chemical industry,
foods, animal husbandry, brewing industry and hospitals, etc. After year's development, FLOM has
gained good reputation among lots of users and the same industry for special patent technique,good

and users. we emphasize ourselves continuous development and innovation. we always put quality and

## Welcome To LabBuild

We craft our designs with precision and care, ensuring they’re both practical and stylish. We
believe that with the right tools, everyone can make incredible discoveries, and we’re excited to be
a part of that process.

[ Book Appointment ][104]

design. We offer consultations and installations tailored to each client’s needs, ensuring that
every laboratory setup is not only functional but also compliant with industry standards. Our team
of experts provides turnkey solutions, managing projects from conception to completion while
prioritizing safety, ergonomics, and minimal operational disruption.

Our product range includes durable, chemical-resistant lab workbenches, custom lab casework and
cabinets designed to fit specific spaces, and a wide variety of laboratory countertops made from
materials like epoxy resin, phenolic resin, stainless steel, and more. LabBuild emphasizes a
hands-on approach by deploying an in-house installation team for every project, avoiding third-party
contractors to ensure quality and consistency.

prioritize safety and ergonomics, while minimizing downtime and disruption.

design. We offer consultations and installations tailored to each client’s needs, ensuring that
every laboratory setup is not only functional but also compliant with industry standards. Our team

prioritizing safety, ergonomics, and minimal operational disruption.

cabinets designed to fit specific spaces, and a wide variety of laboratory countertops made from

hands-on approach by deploying an in-house installation team for every project, avoiding third-party

prioritize safety and ergonomics, while minimizing downtime and disruption.

## [Products][150]

## [Casework][151]

All in-stock **stainless-steel, painted steel, wood and phenolic casework** have a powder coated
finish that is **SEFA 8 compliant**. A wide range of colors and cabinet styles.

[ View ][152]

## [Wood Workspace][153]

[ [Wood Workspace] ][154]

Modular Lab Wood Workspace to be the **long-lasting casework** solution for active, changing
workflow interiors. The structural frame gives you progressive adaptability to reconstruct and reuse
modules.

[ View ][155]

## [Shelving Systems][156]

[ [Shelving Systems] ][157]

Laboratory shelving systems for bench and wall mount. **Heavy-duty steel, wire shelving, and
phenolic shelving** make a perfect solution for all lab applications.

[ View ][158]

## [Lab Benches][159]

[ [Lab Benches] ][160]

Can be ordered in different depths, with special edge details, with extra high back-splashes, or a
variety of cutouts. Modular lab benches provide a **stable and vibration resistant work-space** for
sensitive procedures.

[ View ][161]

## [Adjustable Tables][162]

[ [Adjustable Lab Tables] ][163]

Adjustable lab tables provide the user with the highest quality and most **flexible lab system**
adapting to the demanding needs and changing equipment.

[ View ][164]

## [Pipettes][165]

[ [Pipettes] ][166]

In labs, it’s important to be accurate and precise. That’s where pipettes come in! Pipettes are
special tools used to **measure and move small amounts of liquids precisely**. They help labs
perform their tasks with exceptional precision and accuracy!

[ View ][167]

# **MUNRO- Laboratory Equipment UK**

Established in 1864, MUNRO has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying scientific equipment to
over 70 countries worldwide. MUNRO quality management systems meet and exceed many worldwide and
country standards. Our expertise in the supply of scientific products is backed by our qualified
design, build and customer service teams.

Discover a wide selection of laboratory instruments for various research and analysis needs. Get
reliable, accurate results with our advanced equipment.

## **Scientific Equipment**

Our mission is to empower scientists and researchers with cutting-edge technology that enhances
accuracy, efficiency, and sustainability. From microbiology to meteorology, MUNRO is your trusted
partner in scientific discovery.



Our commitment is to provide scientists, researchers, and medical professionals with the tools they
need to make accurate and precise measurements, so they can focus on their work. We understand the
importance of having reliable equipment and strive to deliver products that meet the highest
standards of quality and performance. Browse our collection and find the perfect solution for your
laboratory today!

# Innovation you can trust.

BetterBuilt manufactures quality washing systems and products for life sciences, laboratory
research, and healthcare.

Looking for a specific product?

## Get the Total Solution with BetterBuilt

At BetterBuilt, we are committed to fully understanding your specific needs, because we know that
each facility is unique. Building on our 70-year legacy of quality and durability, partnered with
our strong engineering abilities, we are dedicated to providing innovative solutions which are easy
to operate, cost-effective to own, and durable for a long life of reliable performance. Watch our
corporate video below.

## Our Industry

BetterBuilt products are found in vivariums and laboratory research facilities and are often used in
healthcare for hospital sterile processing and surgical departments.

[ [icon---life-sciences][icon---life-sciences] ][72]

## Life Sciences

Engineering solutions for the lab animal science and vivarium research facility. Washers and dryers,
bedding management, automation systems, dry heat sterilizers, and more.

[Learn more][73]

[ [icon - laboratory][icon - laboratory] ][74]

## Laboratory

Complete solutions for the pharmaceutical and laboratory facility. Glassware washers and dryers,
automation, decontamination, and necropsy fixtures.

[Learn more][75]

[ [icon---healthcare][icon---healthcare] ][76]

## Healthcare

Innovative solutions for healthcare facilities and central sterile processing applications.
Decontamination, automation systems, cart and utensil washers, surgical scrub sinks and warming
cabinets.

[Learn more][77]

## Featured Case Study

While UBC was making plans to build their new research facility, Gordon Grey, Senior Operations
Manager of Animal Care Services, knew he wanted BetterBuilt on the team as a key …

[Read about it][78]

## Get the Total Solution with BetterBuilt

At BetterBuilt, we are committed to fully understanding your specific needs, because we know that
each facility is unique. Building on our 70-year legacy of quality and durability, partnered with
our strong engineering abilities, we are dedicated to providing innovative solutions which are easy
to operate, cost-effective to own, and durable for a long life of reliable performance. Watch our
corporate video below.

## Our Industry

BetterBuilt products are found in vivariums and laboratory research facilities and are often used in
healthcare for hospital sterile processing and surgical departments.

automation, decontamination, and necropsy fixtures.

cabinets.

## Setting up your lab in Budget

RA Lab has established itself as a supplier of laboratory furniture and equipment. We have evolved
into a one-stop shop for businesses wishing to set up their lab on a budget.

### Space Managment & Material Selection

Space management and material selection are critical factors in the design of a laboratory. Proper
space management ensures that the laboratory is functional, safe, and efficient. It involves
carefully planning the layout and allocation of space to ensure that the equipment and personnel
have sufficient room to operate effectively. Material selection, on the other hand, is important
because it directly affects the durability, safety, and functionality of the laboratory.

[Know more!][54]

### Efficiency & Safety

A well-designed laboratory can greatly improve efficiency and safety. A well-thought-out layout with
an efficient work flow is critical for implementing efficiency. This can be accomplished by
logically organising laboratory equipment and supplies and ensuring easy access to frequently used
items. Lighting and ventilation are also important factors in increasing efficiency. To ensure
safety, the design should include appropriate hazardous material storage areas, fire suppression
systems, and emergency exits (e.g., spill containment). Furthermore, proper ergonomics should be
considered to reduce physical strain on laboratory personnel.

more than 100 years of experience, Retsch develops innovative solutions for neutral-to-analysis

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

Why utility-scale operators choose Taypro

## Returns are won in operations, not panel capex alone

One accountable partner from robot to fleet software: recover generation, cut water and labour risk,
and monitor every block on [NECTYR][45]. See how [dual-pass dry cleaning][46] works in the field.

### Recover lost MWh

Soiling and blind O&M can cost 8–25% of annual generation on Indian utility plants. Waterless
robotic cleaning recovers yield with predictable, data-logged cycles, not calendar crews alone.

### Consistent performance ratio

Scheduled dry cycles help keep performance ratio stable through dusty seasons, without water
logistics or crew availability gaps.

### Highest uptime guarantee

Taypro targets industry-leading robot availability with pan-India spares, NECTYR remote diagnostics,
and structured AMC support.

### Same-day breakdown resolution

Field engineers and regional inventory support same-day on-site response across India, backed by
NECTYR ticketing.

## Advanced solar panel cleaning robot technology

Patented hardware and connectivity designed for dusty, utility-scale sites, documented across [live
deployments][47].

### Patented dual-pass cleaning

Airflow lifts dry dust first, then microfiber completes the wipe, see our cleaning technology page
for the full methodology.

### RF mesh & fleet connectivity

LTE, Wi-Fi, hybrid RF mesh, LoRa, and LoRaWAN, sized per site so robots and NECTYR stay connected in
the field.

### AI/ML scheduling

Automatic cleaning robots adjust cycle cadence from weather and soiling inputs, fewer wasted runs,
more predictable O&M.

### Made in India

Designed and manufactured at our Chakan, Pune hub with TÜV NORD certified hardware and patents on
core cleaning systems.

### Self-learning fleet AI

AI that improves cleaning decisions with each cycle across the full fleet, soiling prediction,
timing, and routing compound with every site added.

### Wet microfiber detection

Sensors detect when cleaning elements are wet from dew or humidity and postpone cycles
automatically, protecting module glass from smear damage.

One accountable partner from robot to fleet software: recover generation, cut water and labour risk,
and monitor every block on [NECTYR][45]. See how [dual-pass dry cleaning][46] works in the field.

### Recover lost MWh

Soiling and blind O&M can cost 8–25% of annual generation on Indian utility plants. Waterless
robotic cleaning recovers yield with predictable, data-logged cycles, not calendar crews alone.

### Consistent performance ratio

Scheduled dry cycles help keep performance ratio stable through dusty seasons, without water
logistics or crew availability gaps.

### Highest uptime guarantee

Taypro targets industry-leading robot availability with pan-India spares, NECTYR remote diagnostics,
and structured AMC support.

### Same-day breakdown resolution

Field engineers and regional inventory support same-day on-site response across India, backed by
NECTYR ticketing.

## Advanced solar panel cleaning robot technology

Patented hardware and connectivity designed for dusty, utility-scale sites, documented across [live
deployments][47].

### Patented dual-pass cleaning

Airflow lifts dry dust first, then microfiber completes the wipe, see our cleaning technology page
for the full methodology.

### RF mesh & fleet connectivity

LTE, Wi-Fi, hybrid RF mesh, LoRa, and LoRaWAN, sized per site so robots and NECTYR stay connected in
the field.

### AI/ML scheduling

Automatic cleaning robots adjust cycle cadence from weather and soiling inputs, fewer wasted runs,
more predictable O&M.

Designed and manufactured at our Chakan, Pune hub with TÜV NORD certified hardware and patents on
core cleaning systems.

### Self-learning fleet AI

AI that improves cleaning decisions with each cycle across the full fleet, soiling prediction,
timing, and routing compound with every site added.

### Wet microfiber detection

Sensors detect when cleaning elements are wet from dew or humidity and postpone cycles
automatically, protecting module glass from smear damage.
